description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location on Southwest Marine Drive in south Vancouver, part of the international chain that notably expanded from Seattle to Vancouver in the late 1980s. The store sits on a busy arterial corridor with outdoor seating, making it a recognizable waypoint for cyclists traveling through this part of the city. A full menu of espresso drinks, seasonal Refreshers, and light food items is available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (4 spaces, secure, paid) at 74m; lockers (4 spaces, secure, paid) at 81m. Total: 8 spaces, 8 secure.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record supplies key amenity tags: takeaway=yes (confirms takeout), internet_access=wlan + internet_access:fee=no (confirms free Wi-Fi), and outdoor_seating=yes. The fetched website is the generic Starbucks Canada corporate homepage (starbucks.ca) with no location-specific content, so bike parking, washrooms, and water refill status cannot be confirmed and remain null. The corporate URL matches the OSM url field (website confirmed), but the specific store phone and address cannot be cross-checked against the corporate site.
concerns: The OSM website URL (https://www.starbucks.ca) resolves to the generic Starbucks Canada corporate homepage, not a location-specific page; store-level details such as phone number, washrooms, and bike parking cannot be verified from it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-known, reliably open chain cafe on Southwest Marine Drive with confirmed free Wi-Fi, outdoor seating, and takeout — a useful and easily recognized food and drink stop for touring cyclists.
